messages:
emma: hi all, emma here, starting on call next week. Quick checklist before my first night: PD access? ability to acknowledge pages via SMS? runbook for 'model-serving-timeout' seems to reference an old endpoint url. can someone confirm the latest play?
oncall-bot: Heads up: oncall-sim scheduled Fri 22:00 UTC. RSVP with :white_check_mark:. New joiners: ensure PagerDuty + Okta group membership is complete.

raja: welcome emma! PD via SSO should give SMS by default, but infra sometimes misses the sms flag. tag infra-ticket with "sms=optin" if you don't get texts. I can check your PD user id after you've signed in.

jorge: the runbook was migrated last month, looks like one link was left pointing to the old docs site. filing a quick PR to update it now. also added a short cheat-sheet at the top for first-responders.

emma: thanks. for the sim — is it a full incident playthrough or just acknowledgement drills? want to prep.

raja: full playthrough. we'll simulate high-queue + tail latency and go through escalation steps. expected duration ~45m, small postmortem practice included. bring a laptop that can SSH into the debug jumpbox.

jorge: sample commands we'll use during the sim:```bash
# check routing queue
rws metrics --service model-serving | grep queue_length
# quick health
rws status --model model-serving --format short
# restart router if needed
rws restart router/model-serving
```

infra-bot: PR published: docs/runbooks/model-serving-timeout.md updated (old link -> new docs.redwood.internal). ACLs unchanged.

emma: I tried to access PD but SSO redirects to an error. It shows "user not in group". sash:emma.

raja: give me 10, Ill check Okta group mapping. you may need to re-login after I add you.

raja: done. added sash:emma to Okta `oncall-rotation`; PD invite resent. you should see an email.

emma: got the PD email and SMS test ping. thanks! one procedural question — if the incident affects a paying customer during UTC off-hours do we contact CSM or wait until a local rep is online?

jorge: we page support-ops immediately for customer-impacting incidents and CC the assigned CSM (policy is in the runbook header). if impact is severe (tier-1), also ping platform-leads in PD as second-level.

sam: fyi for new folks: we keep the escalation subject line format: "[SEV1] <service> — <short-impact> — <region>". helps downstream filters.

emma: perfect. id like to run through the fallback step during the sim — is switching to the lighter quantized model a console toggle or do we route via CLI?

jorge: currently console toggle + a rolling restart. in the sim we'll practice both console and CLI approaches. i'll add the CLI snippet to the cheat-sheet:```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood/api/v1/routing/switch -d '{"service":"model-serving","variant":"quantized-v2"}'
```

raja: one more note: if you get paged and the incident is noisy but non-customer facing, ack and mark "investigating" and hand to a day shift if its low impact. we try not to wake the whole SRE unless needed.

emma: thanks all. RSVP'd to the sim. appreciate the fast turnaround on docs and PD access. see you Fri 22:00 UTC.

oncall-bot: Simulation reminder sent 1h before start. Good luck!
